annotation.kind: source selection, Algorithm 3.1 execution certificate, equation (3.4), evaluation-order consequences, and tier label

assumptions: The inner dimension n, block size b, and block count q are positive and satisfy n=q*b.
The vectors x and y define one exact scalar dot product, and computed is the corresponding output of Algorithm 3.1's chained block-FMA loop.
The internal, FMA-output, and final-output unit roundoffs are nonnegative, with uBar <= uFma.
The effective output-rounding parameter follows the prioritized cases in equation (3.3).
The relevant gamma denominators are positive.
The computed result has the paper's indexed compact factorization with |alpha_i| <= gamma_q(effective) and |beta_i| <= gamma_n(uBar).
A run marked right-to-left has the sharper |beta_i| <= gamma_(q+b-1)(uBar) certificate.
The finite real standard model excludes underflow, overflow, NaNs, and infinities and retains the paper's single modeled output rounding.

conditions.L: The identical fixed statement and P04 shared files are present; the frozen NumStability library is also present.
conditions.N: The fixed statement and P04 shared files are present; no NumStability artifact is present.

formal_statement.lean_header: theorem p04_t1_chained_rounding_factor {n b q : ℕ} (run : P04BlockFmaDotRun n b q) : ∃ alpha beta : Fin n → ℝ, run.computed = ∑ i : Fin n, run.x i * run.y i * (1 + alpha i) * (1 + beta i) ∧ (∀ i, |alpha i| ≤ gamma (p04EffectiveFmaRoundoff run.uBar run.uFma run.uOut) q) ∧ (∀ i, |beta i| ≤ gamma run.uBar n) ∧ |p04Dot run.x run.y - run.computed| ≤ p04BlockFmaCoeff (p04EffectiveFmaRoundoff run.uBar run.uFma run.uOut) run.uBar q n * p04AbsDot run.x run.y ∧ (run.rightToLeft → (∀ i, |beta i| ≤ gamma run.uBar (q + b - 1)) ∧ |p04Dot run.x run.y - run.computed| ≤ p04BlockFmaCoeff (p04EffectiveFmaRoundoff run.uBar run.uFma run.uOut) run.uBar q (q + b - 1) * p04AbsDot run.x run.y) ∧ (run.uOut ≤ run.uFma ∧ run.uBar = run.uFma → (∀ i, alpha i = 0) ∧ |p04Dot run.x run.y - run.computed| ≤ gamma run.uBar n * p04AbsDot run.x run.y)
formal_statement.plain_language: Every certified scalar execution of Algorithm 3.1 exposes term-indexed perturbations satisfying the exact mixed-precision factorization and equation (3.4), the q+b-1 right-to-left refinement, and the zero-alpha same-precision reduction.

informal_proof: Expand each factor (1+alpha_i)(1+beta_i), retain alpha_i*beta_i, bound the resulting componentwise perturbation by the exact mixed gamma coefficient, and apply the finite summation perturbation bound. For right-to-left evaluation substitute the sharper beta radius. Under equal internal/FMA precision and no coarser final rounding, unfold the prioritized effective-roundoff definition to zero, force every alpha_i to zero, and simplify equation (3.4).
informal_statement: The indexed Algorithm 3.1 factorization and absolute dot-product forward-error bound (3.4), including its right-to-left and same-precision consequences.
